- REAL BUG (fixed): detect_mss + detect_liquidity sliced the swing-filtered Series by label ([window_start:i] on a non-contiguous Int64Index), so the lookback width silently varied with swing density and pulled future bars in; fixed by precomputing np.flatnonzero(swing) and slicing by original bar index

- EWM-based indicators show warmup-history dependence by construction (recursive_check K=300) - handled via startup_candle_count, not repaint
